/.meta_description: Podpadi Ubud is a hidden gem located in a serene and tranquil setting, offering breathtaking views of the majestic Mount Agung and the vibrant green rice fields. Surrounded by nature, this peaceful retreat provides the perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of daily life. Whether you’re looking to unwind, explore the local culture, or simply enjoy the beauty of Ubud, Podpadi offers a unique and immersive experience that allows you to connect with the beauty of Bali’s natural landscape.

sections.heading: Hello!
sections.body:
I’m Made, your host and the manager of Podpadi. Our goal is simple yet profound: to assure that our guests have a delightful and unforgettable experience while staying with us. We understand that a great stay is about more than just comfortable accommodations;
it’s about creating lasting memories. We take great pride in our hospitality whether it's providing personalized recommendations or attending to your needs, we are here to make your visit unforgettable.

sections.heading: Our Story
sections.body: We're a group of hospitality innovators with expertise in property management, architecture, and design. We've been leading the charge in creating the vision for PodPadi, and we're excited to bring it to life for you. Our dedicated team are here to ensure that you have the best possible experience, both in person and virtually. We are eagerly anticipating your arrival and committed to delivering exceptional customer service throughout your stay."

slide_1.name: Shannon
slide_1.text: Incredible stay in Ubud, Made was a great host and it was a pleasure to stay - only wish we had longer.

slide_1.name: Marco
slide_1.text: Such a beautiful property, everything was great and exactly as in the pictures. While the access road is about a minute walk only accessible by foot and motorcycles (common for rice paddy villas), it’s paved and they’re always happy to assist with your luggage. Close to a handful of restaurants and easily located when catching a grab/gojek. Terima kasih

slide_1.name: Lígia
slide_1.text: An unforgettable stay! The property is stunning, serene, and impeccably maintained. The staff went above and beyond with their efficiency and kindness. Three days felt far too short in this little slice of paradise!

slide_1.name: Callum
slide_1.text: We loved staying somewhere so quiet, calm and private, with a beautiful view but only a short ride into town.

slide_1.name: Dahlia
slide_1.text: The hosts and workers were super nice and accommodating! Breakfast was very tasty as well. The villa itself is beautiful and very clean. The space around as well is nice. Not too far from everything either but still secluded away in its own spot ! Definitely would recommend if you’re looking for a villa in ubud!

slide_2.name: Lorena
slide_2.date: 2 weeks ago (relative date at time of screenshot)
slide_2.text:
We LOVED it here! We were for almost 4 months in Asia and this was without doubt, the best Airbnb where we stayed at.
The views from the pool are amazing and the staff is incredible (they are so attentive! Plus via phone we got all the information we needed from the appartment and things to do in Ubud + the owner replied really fast)
The Bungalow has charm and everything was so clean and beautiful! There’s nothing we can complain about.
For sure we will go back when we visit Ubud again :).

slide_2.name: Ryan
slide_2.text: We had a lovely time at Pod Padi and Made was very helpful arranging transport throughout our time. The villa has breakfast options in the morning.

slide_2.name: Kangozhayev
slide_2.text: Chic place, thank you Made, everything was great😍😍😍

slide_2.name: Alan
slide_2.text: Perfect stay in a very peaceful part of Ubud away from the noise and business of the town. Super host. Proactive and helpful. Wouldn’t hesitate to return

slide_2.name: Mikala
slide_2.text: Beautiful location! The host Made was so nice and helpful. Will definitely be back :)

slide_3.name: Marina
slide_3.text: Friendly and communicative staff, clean and practical room, and lovely space! Great to have a private pool and also the shared pool with views to the rice fields

slide_3.name: Kasper
slide_3.text:
Incredible resort
Staff is so friendly and helpful
They made my girlfriends birthday a day to remember by decorating the pool with thousands of flowers.
Thank you so very much for a peaceful stay!
Will be returning

slide_3.name: Pauline
slide_3.text: Nice, stylish place with dedicated staff. Clean, well-maintained and simply chic. Very tasty breakfast and juices!

slide_3.name: Abhishek
slide_3.text:
We stayed at different places during our trip to Bali and we're glad we had our longest stay here in Ubud. The property is gorgeous, serene and extremely well maintained. As soon as you enter the compound, you're greeted by a lovely swimming pool overlooking the lush green ricefields. BONUS TIP: Wake up by 6 and rush to the pool area to catch a lovely sunset view.
But really, the biggest highlight is the host - Made, one of the nicest and most helpful hosts we've met. The property is a bit tricky to locate when you arrive the first time but Made was in touch with us throughout, proactively reaching out to us to confirm if we need any help witj transport or directions. He remained available for any help we needed and ensured we have the most comfortable stay possible.
